$comment: Generated from src/modules/forms by `pnpm openapi:generate`; do not edit. The rules of the public forms (ADR-09, M3-BE-02) and the vectors both the server and the browser must pass: for each answers vector, the same errors (path and code, in this order) and, where given, the same kept values. Paths name a field by its key and a block of a repeating section by its index from 0: authors[2].email.
order: The errors come in this order: keys the definition does not have, in the order of the answers; then the sections in order, and in each its fields in order (a repeating section: the count of blocks, then each block in order).
shown: A field is shown when its section is shown and its visibleWhen holds (the answer of `field`, trimmed, is one of `in`); in a repeating section a field with onlyFirstInRepeat only in the first block. A field that is not shown is not checked and not kept.
values: text, longText, email, choice, yesNo and file take a string; consent takes a boolean (true: given). Every string is composed (NFC) and trimmed; empty is the same as left out. An email address keeps its local part and lower-cases its domain.
characters: Refused in every text (invalidCharacters): control characters (in a longText the tab, the line break and the carriage return are allowed), U+200E, U+200F, U+202A to U+202E, U+2066 to U+2069 and U+FEFF. For an email field the code is notAnEmail.
checks: In this order, the first that fails gives the code: wrong JSON type (wrongType); empty and required (required; a consent that is not true); more characters (code points) than rules.maxLength (tooLong); choice and yesNo: not an option (notAnOption); file: not a UUID (wrongType); email: not one plain address (notAnEmail); characters (invalidCharacters); more words than rules.maxWords (tooManyWords); the pattern (pattern); the URL rule when rules.noUrl (noUrl).

wordCount.rule: Runs of characters between white space (JavaScript /\s+/u) of the trimmed text.

noUrl.rule: Refused: a scheme with // (https://), www., mailto:, a mail address, a host name followed by a path. A dotted word alone is a word.

emailAddress.rule: The address rule (ADR-09): one plain address of at most 254 characters, a local part of at most 64 of the dot-atom of RFC 5322, a domain of at least two labels, the last of two letters at least. No display name, comma, angle bracket, space or control character.

safeText.rule: Form texts are plain text; [label](target) is a link when the target is an https address or one of the named links, otherwise it stays text. The named links are the consent links of the conference (D6); a named link the conference has no address for is shown as its label.

vectors.text: I accept the [terms of publication](terms) and the [privacy notice](privacy).

proofOfWork.rule: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text challenge + ":" + counter begins with at least difficulty zero bits; counter is a decimal number of at most 12 digits, without leading zeros.
